name: Veilborn
storyline:
In a world shrouded by the mysterious Veil, generations of heroes venture into dangerous lands, facing ancient guardians and creatures born from darkness.

From the forgotten territories of the Lands of the Veil to the volcanic depths of the Crown of the Furnace, every expedition brings new dangers and challenges.

At the heart of the last forge awaits a colossal enemy, a formidable obstacle for those who dare to venture into its domain.

Each fallen hero leaves behind a legacy. Others rise to continue the journey, carrying the hope of reaching farther than those who came before them.

In Veilborn, death is not the end of the story. It is part of an ongoing cycle of struggle, survival and inheritance.
summary:
Veilborn is a single-player 2D action roguelite set in a dark fantasy world.

Players explore hostile regions, battle dangerous creatures and powerful bosses, and develop their heroes across successive expeditions.

The game features multiple playable heroes, character progression, equipment preparation and a camp that serves as a base between expeditions.

Players can explore two distinct regions: the mysterious Lands of the Veil and the volcanic Crown of the Furnace, home to the Colossus of the Last Forge.

Death is part of the experience, with each fallen hero contributing to an ongoing legacy.

Veilborn was developed by BLACKSHADOW using the Godot engine and was released as a free-to-play PC game on October 14, 2026.
